articles.title: Beatrice Sokolov, 69, Longtime Volunteer
articles.deck: Friends remember Beatrice Sokolov for the many years of service to Marsh Landing.
body: Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Foundry Row Mutual Aid Group in his or her name. Born in Marsh Landing in the years after the war, Beatrice Sokolov spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood.
Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Marsh Landing. Beatrice Sokolov died in April at home on Dayton Road, at the age of 69.
Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Foundry Row Mutual Aid Group in his or her name.
